name: Yakitori chicken skewer rice bowl
description: Miso-honey chicken skewers with jasmine rice, pickled radish, mangetout and sesame mayo. Serves 2, ready in 40 minutes.

steps.name: Prep and marinate
steps.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 200C and put the bamboo skewers in water to soak. Halve the lime. Slice the green parts of the spring onions thinly and set aside for serving; cut the white parts into thirds.

Mix the soy sauce, miso paste and honey in a large bowl, then transfer half to a mug and save it for the glaze. Whisk a drizzle of oil into what is left in the bowl.

Cut the chicken thighs into 2cm chunks, add to the bowl and mix to coat. Cover and leave to marinate. Wash your hands and everything the raw chicken touched.

steps.name: Marinate
steps.instructions: Chicken sits covered in the marinade. Nothing to do.

steps.name: Thread skewers
steps.instructions: Line a baking tray with foil. Thread the chicken and the spring onion whites onto the soaked skewers, two per person. Lay them lengthways on the tray, spaced apart. Pour over any marinade left in the bowl, drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.

steps.name: Roast skewers
steps.instructions: Into the oven. Turn the skewers halfway. Done when charred at the edges and no longer pink inside.

steps.name: Assemble and serve
steps.instructions: Divide the rice between two bowls. Add the mangetout, pickled radish, a spoon of sesame mayo and the chicken skewers. Drizzle the glaze over, scatter with the spring onion greens and serve with lime wedges.

steps.name: Pickle the radishes
steps.instructions: Trim and thinly slice the radishes. Mix the rice vinegar with 1/2 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt in a small bowl, add the radishes and set aside. They only need the time they get.

steps.name: Toast sesame, make mayo
steps.instructions: Dry frying pan over medium heat, no oil. Toast the sesame seeds for 1-2 minutes until golden, stirring often so they don't catch. Tip into a bowl, mix with the mayonnaise and a splash of water, then season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

steps.name: Boil the water
steps.instructions: 300g water into a saucepan, lid on, bring to the boil.

steps.name: Cook the rice
steps.instructions: Salt the water, stir in the rice, drop the heat to medium and cover. Leave it alone.

steps.name: Rest the rice
steps.instructions: Off the heat, lid still on. It will hold happily until you serve.

steps.name: Make the glaze
steps.instructions: Cut the lime into wedges. Squeeze the juice of half the lime into the sauce you saved in the mug and mix. Pour into a frying pan and simmer over medium heat for a minute, stirring, until slightly thickened.

steps.name: Fry the mangetout
steps.instructions: Oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the mangetout, season with salt and pepper and stir fry until tender with a bit of bite left.
